offering_description.value: Rents construction, industrial and infrastructure equipment to contractors, industrial firms, municipalities and event organizers. Also sells used equipment, parts and supplies, and provides engineered equipment solutions. Delivers through a network of branches and a company-owned rental fleet.

primary_products.value: used rental equipment; contractor supplies; parts and accessories

primary_services.value: aerial work platform rental; earthmoving equipment rental; specialty equipment rental (power, climate control, pumps); engineered equipment solutions; safety services

customer_segment.value: B2B: construction contractors, industrial and manufacturing firms, facility operators, event and entertainment companies; B2G: municipalities and government infrastructure projects

end_markets.value: construction; infrastructure; industrial and manufacturing; energy and petrochemical; events and entertainment

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: equipment rental fees for aerial lifts, earthmoving, power and specialty equipment; product sales: sales of used rental equipment, parts, supplies and merchandise; service fees: delivery, fuel, damage waivers and engineered solutions services
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates a rental fleet bought from equipment manufacturers, rented to contractors and industrial customers; distributor: resells used equipment, parts and supplies to customers and dealers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with branches across both countries

specialization.value: related lines: general construction equipment rental, specialty rental, engineered solutions and used equipment sales

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated rental branches and specialty locations; direct sales: national and key account sales teams; online: website and app for rentals and account management

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: equipment safety, emissions and transport rules from OSHA, EPA and DOT, environmental rules on fuel and fleet
